exact: positive regulation of dentine-containing tooth bud formation by mesenchymal-epithelial signalling
related: positive regulation of dentine-containing tooth bud formation by mesenchymal-epithelial signaling

definition: Any process that initiates the formation of a tooth bud by the secretion of a signal from a mesenchymal cell and its reception and subsequent change in the identity of an epithelial cell of the tooth bud.
